name: Virtù

rounds.endCondition: 21 rounds, or France controls Naples at end of a round

roles.label: Naples
roles.winCondition: Most Prestige Points after 21 rounds; wins ties.

roles.label: France
roles.winCondition: Immediate win if France controls Naples at the end of a round; otherwise most Prestige Points.

categories.label: Cities controlled
categories.hint: 1 VP per City, including starting Cities and Cities controlled by an Allied Major City.

categories.label: Prestige on cards/tiles
categories.hint: Prestige Points printed on Palace cards and Domain tiles.

categories.label: Cross symbols (religious influence)
categories.hint: Player with more Crosses gets 2 VP; tie gives nobody anything.

categories.label: Trophies (incl. Major Cities)
categories.hint: 1 VP per Trophy; all count even from the same colour.

categories.label: Indulgence cards in Palace
categories.hint: -1 VP per Indulgence card still in Palace.

categories.label: France controls Naples (automatic win)
categories.hint: Check if France controls Naples at the end of a round: France wins immediately.

tiebreakers.description: On a tie in Prestige Points, Naples wins.

winCondition: Most Prestige Points after 21 rounds (Naples wins ties). France wins immediately if it controls Naples at the end of any round.

endCondition.description: 21 rounds or France controlling Naples at end of round.

notes: family: engine-building + area-majority. Two-player Wars of Italy rules: no Patronage or track VP; Major Cities are scored via Allied control. Players are asymmetric (Naples vs France); the tie goes to Naples.

sources.title: Virtù: The Wars of Italy - 2 player rulebook (Super Meeple, EN)
sources.section: p.12 End of the Game: Prestige and Victory; Automatic Victory
